SMTO-GWT-0068 — SMTO can't change this GPU's compute mode

GUID: 752b5d7b-dbfa-507d-9a07-fa51cda30bfa
Slug: gpu-compute-mode-unsupported
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gpu

What happened

  • The compute mode controls whether several programs can share the graphics card. This card or its driver doesn't let SMTO change it, so nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, ask SMTO to show the details for this GPU and look for its compute mode. If no compute mode is shown, the card or driver doesn't report one, and SMTO can't change it.
  2. If no compute mode is shown, ask the person who manages the GPU computer to check that the NVIDIA driver is current and allows compute mode changes. SMTO needs the installed NVIDIA tools to offer the compute mode option, and the driver can still refuse it.
  3. Once the driver is confirmed, ask SMTO again to set the compute mode to default, prohibited or exclusive process. The earlier request was refused before any change, so repeating it is safe once support is in place.

What success looks like

  • SMTO confirms the new compute mode, and the GPU details show the same mode.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages the computer with the GPU. Don't ask for other mode names; SMTO only supports default, prohibited and exclusive process.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Compute-mode configuration was refused because the requested mode is not in the device's supported-mode list (empty when the device reports no compute mode or nvidia-smi lacks --compute-mode), or the provider rejected the change as unsupported.

What this means

  • The requested compute mode was absent from the current supported-mode list, or provider rejection was classified as unsupported compute control. The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.

Why this can happen

  • The requested compute mode was absent from the current supported-mode list, or provider rejection was classified as unsupported compute control.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested mode with the device's current configuration capabilities.

How to fix it

  • Run gpu.device for the UUID and confirm compute_mode is non-null, and check that nvidia-smi --help on the Gateway host lists --compute-mode. Only default, prohibited and exclusive_process are supported; update the NVIDIA driver if the mode cannot be reported or set.
  • Inspect current device capabilities and driver support.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect current device capabilities and driver support.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported authorized compute mode is applied and its readback matches.

What not to do

  • Do not replay uncertain mutations, kill GPU clients automatically or invent sensor values.

Technical notes

  • The retained phase, target and receipt determine what executed. Rendering this definition adds no probe, retries, dispatch or changes to resource ownership.
